name: AutoTotem-Plugin 1.1.2
changelog:
## AutoTotem v1.1.2

### ✨ New Features
- **Multi-version single Jar**: All supported versions (1.20.1 ~ 26.2) merged into one Jar — download once, drop in, done
- **PVP toggle**: New `pvp-enabled` config option to control whether auto-totem triggers on player-caused lethal damage (enabled by default)
- **Server default cooldown command**: New `/autototem setdefaultcooldown [tick]` (OP only) to change the server-wide default cooldown in-game
- **Cooldown floor**: Player-set cooldowns can no longer go below the server default

### 🔧 Improvements
- Restored the vanilla totem animation (fixed missing particle burst on trigger)
- Startup log now prints plugin version, server version, and active adapter for easier troubleshooting
- Tab completion is now permission-aware — non-admin players no longer see admin-only subcommands
- `/autototem reload` is now OP-only by default

### 🔒 Permissions
- New `autototem.admin` permission (default: op)
- New `autototem.reload` permission (default: op)

### 🐛 Fixes
- Fixed missing totem resurrection animation on trigger
- Fixed stale build-cache artifacts

**Supported servers**: Paper 1.20.1 ~ 26.2

name: AutoTotem-Plugin 1.0-SNAPSHOT
changelog:
### Added

- Automatically consumes a totem of undying from your inventory on a fatal hit, saving you from death
- Replicates the vanilla totem effects (Regeneration II, Absorption IV, Fire Resistance I) with sound and particles
- Per-player toggle and cooldown (ticks) via `/autototem enabled` and `/autototem cooldowntime`
- Multi-language support: English (en-US) and Simplified Chinese (zh-CN), auto-selected by client language
- `/autototem reload` to reload the config, `/autototem help` for help, full tab-completion
- Paper 1.20.1 support (API 1.20, Java 17+)
